headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty ended the weekly wrap up 2% as markets rebounded ahead of Diwali week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Sensex and Nifty50 rose 2% overall in the weekly wrap, led by gains in Trent.
Early session buying in Reliance and foreign inflows supported market gains.
Adani Ports surged 4% during early trade momentum.
Nifty Smallcap 100 index jumped 4% over the weekly tracking period.
whatHappening: Government raised export duties on diesel and aviation fuel while scrapping the petrol levy.
Crude oil prices hovering above $116 and rising India VIX maintained volatile trading conditions.
Market outlook for the Nov 2-6 week focuses on whether bulls can deliver a Diwali rally.
Foreign portfolio investment (FPI) inflows and crude triggers remain key factors for market direction.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices posted a 2% gain in the weekly wrap led by rallies in key heavyweights.
Buying in Reliance, Trent, and Adani Ports along with foreign inflows provided strong support.
Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 2 November.
